notes.title: Hotfix 2.2.2 - Another focus issue fix
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow workers,

We've been having a few issues with focus, which is about right when you have humanoid co-workers. They do like to dream and think about their plans for the weekends or where they're going on their holidays, so I've implemented a much better solution: More robot co-workers! Robot co-workers will be more reliable, they will be more supportive when you need a shoulder to cry on and they'll save me some much needed cash (I've got my eye on another yacht and she's a beauty!).

So, the focus issue should be solved (no more error message when the main game window loses focus) and most of the staff have now been replaced by A.I. Remember, we're all one big family here so let's pull together and make this work!

Thanks again for your patience. Please keep reporting issues to HR for further interrogation.

Many kind regards,
The CEO.

notes.title: Hotfix 3: 2.2.0 Steamdeck focus issue
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow workers,

Following on from this mornings meeting re: tiny screen issue, there have been some focus issues reported by some employees working via Steamdeck. The programmer responsible for the Steamdeck focus code has been sent to the maze with the Managerbots and I hope that this is the end of the issue once and for all. When the Steam overlay is brought up, the game will now regain focus when it is closed. It seems like such a simple thing, yet ..

Should you encounter any more issues, please continue to report them to HR for further interrogation.

Thank you for your patience.

Sincerely,
The CEO.

notes.title: Hotfix to 2.1.3 - dPad input fix
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow workers!

This hotfix addresses the dPad not making any sense issue. The employee responsible for this programming mistake will be sent to the maze with the angry managerbots.

Thank you for your patience. Please continue to report any further issues to HR.

Thank you,
The CEO.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.1.1 for screen size launch issue!
notes.notes:
Hello, workers,

This is a quick hotfix to sort out an issue that some people (thanks, IDK Media!) found when launching the game and it would start in a tiny window. The IT department have upgraded windows to the full (screen) version.

Security servers also no longer have a hole in the shield that could be used to access them without dealing with the shield terminals first. This led to many people not doing their full workload in the server rooms. Quite unnacceptable!

Please report any further issues you have to HR and we'll get right on them. Now, back to those TPS reports..!

Yours sincerely,
The CEO.
